name: Systemic Protagonist Rubric
description: Evaluation criteria for rendering a system as a legible protagonist without faking agency: character-sheet rigour, agency repair, gateway discipline, perceptibility, climax legitimacy, and accountability.

criteria.name: Revealed Objective Function Rigour
criteria.description: Whether the character sentence is derived from outcomes across multiple regimes with citations, rather than from rhetoric or a single episode

scores.1: No character sentence, or the revealed purpose is just the stated purpose restated
scores.2: Character sentence asserted with no outcome list or citations
scores.3: Outcome list present with citations, but the sentence rests on a single regime or episode
scores.4: Character sentence supported by cited behaviour in two distinct regimes; constraints and loops documented
scores.5: Two-regime support plus per-loop delay and quantity, constraints sourced individually, and a stated result code (confirmed / unsupported / regime split)

criteria.name: Residual and Overfit Control
criteria.description: Whether outcomes the objective function fails to explain are named, classified, and carried into the finished piece

scores.1: Every outcome is read as intended; the system is written as a coherent malign optimiser
scores.2: Residual field left empty or filled with a token disclaimer
scores.3: At least one unexplained outcome named, but it does not appear in the finished piece
scores.4: Unexplained outcomes named, classified as incompetence / path dependence / noise, and present in the piece
scores.5: As 4, plus the fit is explicitly interrogated — the analysis states what would falsify the character sentence and shows it was checked

criteria.name: Agency Repair Quality
criteria.description: Whether intentional and teleological verbs on non-agentive subjects were relocated to real actors, mechanisms, or selection pressures rather than deleted

scores.1: Systems want, decide, learn, and punish throughout; no ledger run
scores.2: Some flagged verbs removed, but replaced with agentless passives; the post-pass passive count rose
scores.3: Most intentional verbs repaired; repairs skew to one type and some are vague ('incentives shifted')
scores.4: All flagged verbs repaired using the four named repairs; agentless passive count did not rise; unrepairable ones logged as research gaps
scores.5: As 4, plus claim typing applied (mechanism / incentive / selection / correlation / attribution) with a back-reference check showing no type upgrades, and a personification budget honoured with each instance's mechanism stated

criteria.name: Gateway Discipline and Cast Disclosure
criteria.description: Whether human entry points stay probes rather than protagonists, and how the cast came to be assembled is stated in the text

scores.1: The piece is a hero's arc with systemic vocabulary; no admission test, no disclosure
scores.2: Gateways admitted informally; no wrongness paragraph and no statement of who declined
scores.3: Gateways mapped to character-sheet lines and a wrongness paragraph written, but no deletion or ratio test
scores.4: Full admission test run including miscalibration and contemporaneous documentation; deletion and ratio tests reported; who declined is stated
scores.5: As 4, plus the absence check is analysed — the text says whether the silence of non-participants flatters anyone, and gateway arcs are written epistemically rather than morally

criteria.name: Perceptibility Without Invention
criteria.description: Whether abstract forces are made visible through sourced instrument-resolution scenes constrained to contemporaneous knowledge

scores.1: Sensory detail generated that is not in the source material
scores.2: Scenes drawn from material but retro-fit later understanding into the observer's mind at the time
scores.3: Scenes sourced and time-constrained, but no threshold stated or no units and normal range given
scores.4: Instrument resolution with units, normal range, threshold, and a contemporaneous document evidencing the observer's actual interpretation
scores.5: As 4, plus the threshold is classified as a property of the system or of the measurement, and a traveling object with representativeness stated and the gimmick test passed

criteria.name: Climax and Form Legitimacy
criteria.description: Whether the peak is a real state transition of the chosen type, or an arc was refused when the material did not support one

scores.1: An arc forced onto material that does not support one; a person's dramatic moment promoted to the system's turning point
scores.2: A climax chosen but of no named type and with no evidence of a state change
scores.3: One of the five legitimate types chosen and staged with a timestamp and a witness
scores.4: Type chosen, staged concretely, and the transfer-function test passed with before/after stated; famous-date check run
scores.5: As 4, plus the form gate is documented, refusal was genuinely available, the denouement re-states the new steady state rather than resolving, and no prescriptive ending was appended

criteria.name: Accountability and Anti-Fatalism
criteria.description: Whether systemic framing is additive to named responsibility, and whether the piece admits that the system has ever changed

scores.1: Systemic framing used to avoid naming decision-makers; every reform attempt fails and unreformability is the conclusion
scores.2: One of the two problems present: either no reverse check or no partial success
scores.3: Reverse check run on some systemic attributions; at least one reform attempt described
scores.4: Every systemic attribution tested for authority and information with named actors added where both hold; at least one partial success or a stated condition of change
scores.5: As 4, plus the reform-attempt ledger records what would have had to be different for each attempt to hold, and the inevitability audit includes a forecast-vs-outcome beat

criteria.name: Artefact Hygiene and Refusal Handling
criteria.description: Whether planning scaffolding stays out of the prose and whether refusal codes are used honestly when the material is thin

scores.1: Strand labels, rung tags, and sheet references leak into the prose; thin material papered over with invention
scores.2: Some scaffolding removed; no refusal codes considered even where the corpus was clearly abstract
scores.3: Prose is clean of scaffolding; refusal codes available but not exercised
scores.4: Scaffolding removed, and NO DRAMATIC ENGINE / INSUFFICIENT GROUND-LEVEL MATERIAL / UNSUPPORTED codes used where warranted, with reasons
scores.5: As 4, plus billboard drift check run against the finished evidence with any change surfaced to the human as a decision, and every admitted scene traced to a character-sheet line
